Corrected individual profile includes interpolation for positions obstructed by the apparatus, but the affected cells are not identified. The decimal precision is copied from the spreadsheet, not an assertion of measurement accuracy. Source label Strix urlensis; cross-sheet/common-name match to Strix uralensis; source spelling/synonym retained here for audit. Owl sample sizes are 1–3 individuals; Strix aluco values reproduced from Martin (1984), not remeasured.

method: ophthalmoscopic reflex technique; corrected to an infinite viewing distance, as reported by authors
